video_title: Denver Nuggets Full Practice Media Availability | 10.8.26

quotes.speaker: Cam Whitmore
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Whitmore on his integration and growth with the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: I feel like this is more of a discipline, dialed in, locked in team from the start
quotes.quote: It is great getting along with the guys. This is my third team, so I feel like this is more of a discipline, dialed in, locked in team from the start of camp to now, so it has been going great.
quotes.social_post: Cam Whitmore on his move to the Nuggets: This is my third team, so I feel like this is more of a discipline, dialed in, locked in team from the start of camp to now.

quotes.speaker: Cam Whitmore
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Whitmore on embracing his opportunity with the Denver Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: I am just happy to be on a basketball team and happy to be on the Nuggets
quotes.quote: I have been through worse in this life. I just got to embrace the opportunity and I am just happy to be on a basketball team and happy to be on the Denver Nuggets who recently won a championship. So, embrace the opportunity and do not really mind the outside noise, but I know what I am capable of and I know what I am here for.
quotes.social_post: Cam Whitmore says he is embracing his new opportunity in Denver: I know what I am capable of and I know what I am here for.

quotes.speaker: Cam Whitmore
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Whitmore credits P3 Sports Science for his physical development
quotes.excerpt: I definitely got to give a shout out to P3 Sports Science back in Santa Barbara
quotes.quote: I definitely got to give a shout out to P3 Sports Science back in Santa Barbara. They definitely worked on my body when I transferred and transformed into the NBA. That was probably about three years ago, four years ago, before I went to the NBA.
quotes.social_post: Cam Whitmore credits P3 Sports Science for his physical development: They definitely worked on my body when I transferred and transformed into the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Cam Whitmore
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Whitmore on Aaron Gordon's leadership and guidance
quotes.excerpt: He definitely tells me where I need to be in the right spots
quotes.quote: I would definitely say Aaron Gordon. He definitely tells me where I need to be in the right spots. If I am going to be out on the floor, that is who I need to look at. Aaron Gordon and more so Nikola Jokic in that type of area where they are on the court. Whatever they do, cut without the ball, how do they get the ball in the perimeter, how do they get the ball from Nikola Jokic. I play off of Nikola Jokic, so that is really the main guys I am working on.
quotes.social_post: Cam Whitmore on learning the Nuggets system: I play off of Nikola Jokic, so that is really the main guys I am working on.

quotes.speaker: Cam Whitmore
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Whitmore on Aaron Gordon's vocal leadership
quotes.excerpt: He is a vocal, aggressive leader. He is very commanding
quotes.quote: He is a vocal, aggressive leader. He is very commanding, and that is what you need from a vet or anybody in the locker room. You need somebody that has a strong voice who you can listen to. Also, he does it on the floor too. He has been having a great two preseason games, which you guys have seen, so definitely good luck.
quotes.social_post: Cam Whitmore on Aaron Gordon: He is a vocal, aggressive leader. He is very commanding, and that is what you need from a vet or anybody in the locker room.

quotes.speaker: Christian Braun
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Braun on the team's progress with crashing and tagging
quotes.excerpt: I think we are good sometimes and sometimes you forget just naturally just sprinting back
quotes.quote: I think we are good sometimes and sometimes you forget just naturally just sprinting back. But the times when we have done good at it, it has been effective and I think we should continue to practice and continue to get used to it. That comes in practice and things like that.
quotes.social_post: Christian Braun on the Nuggets defensive transition: The times when we have done good at it, it has been effective and I think we should continue to practice and continue to get used to it.

quotes.speaker: Christian Braun
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Braun on the pressure of finishing Nikola Jokic's passes
quotes.excerpt: There is definitely pressure when he throws you the ball just in general
quotes.quote: There is definitely pressure when he throws you the ball just in general. You want to make the play. I do not know if it is pressure because he is throwing you the ball, you just want to make a play. Obviously when he throws like a behind the back from the opposite corner, you really want to hit it. So, it is definitely a different one when he throws a crazy pass, a different feeling, so you just want to make the play for him.
quotes.social_post: Christian Braun on catching passes from Nikola Jokic: Obviously when he throws like a behind the back from the opposite corner, you really want to hit it.

quotes.speaker: Christian Braun
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Braun on implementing new team concepts during preseason
quotes.excerpt: There is always new stuff, there is always new things you are trying to emphasize
quotes.quote: There is always new stuff, there is always new things you are trying to emphasize. Maybe something you are trying to get better at from last year, maybe something you are trying to completely change. There is definitely some things that we are looking at, we are trying to implement in the end of the preseason to get used to it now, and then we will get into our base defense as we go.
quotes.social_post: Christian Braun says the Nuggets are using the end of the preseason to implement new defensive concepts.

quotes.speaker: Christian Braun
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Braun on learning to defend players in isolation
quotes.excerpt: My mentality stays the same since I have been guarding anybody
quotes.quote: My mentality stays the same since I have been guarding anybody. Anybody my opponents since I have been guarding in the NBA. It can be Nikola Jokic, it can be DeMar DeRozan, it can be Kevin Durant, it can be LeBron James. My mentality does not go nowhere.
quotes.social_post: Christian Braun on his defensive mentality: It can be Nikola Jokic, it can be DeMar DeRozan, it can be Kevin Durant, it can be LeBron James. My mentality does not go nowhere.

quotes.speaker: Christian Braun
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Braun praises Alpha's defensive impact in practice
quotes.excerpt: He is awesome. He is great today in practice. He is physical, he can use his hands
quotes.quote: He is awesome. He is great today in practice. He is physical, he can use his hands, he is not scared of a challenge. I just like who he is as a person too. He comes in, he does the work, he works really hard, and Alpha is going to be great for us. He has been great for us already, and he is going to continue to be great for us.
quotes.social_post: Christian Braun on teammate Alpha: He is physical, he can use his hands, he is not scared of a challenge. Alpha is going to be great for us.

quotes.speaker: Michael Malone
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Malone on Cam Whitmore's development and patience
quotes.excerpt: I also think he is a 22-year-old kid and we always talk about second chances
quotes.quote: I also think he is a 22-year-old kid and we always talk about second chances. I think we all got nine chances when you are young. And so, this is just a maturation for him, another chance for him. The kid is extremely talented. I have to stop myself, because I really mean this, our two draft picks are older than him and he has been in the NBA for a while now. So, it is patience is key with him, but he is learning the game, learning how we play.

quotes.speaker: Michael Malone
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Malone on the team concept and Cam Whitmore's growth
quotes.excerpt: I think it is just the team concept stuff. All young guys are the same
quotes.quote: I think it is just the team concept stuff. All young guys are the same. The team defense, there is a lot to it. Every time you play somebody new, there is special players in those teams, they run different systems, there is so much to learn, and to make it just second nature to you, it takes a while. And then offensively, Cam Whitmore, when he plays with the second unit, he can play to his strengths. When he plays with the first unit, which he has not yet, he is going to have to learn to play off the ball.
quotes.social_post: Michael Malone on Cam Whitmore role: When he plays with the second unit, he can play to his strengths. When he plays with the first unit, he is going to have to learn to play off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Michael Malone
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Malone on coaching young players and teaching patience
quotes.excerpt: Don't expect him to, you know, just know something before you don't teach it
quotes.quote: Be patient. Don't expect him to, you know, just know something before you don't teach it. We are all very lucky in this league that when you take over a team or you go to a different team and any position as a coach, you have veteran players. You forget that some of this stuff has to be taught that you think would be easier second nature to you. It is not, and that is at every level of basketball.
quotes.social_post: Michael Malone on coaching young players: Don't expect him to just know something before you don't teach it. You forget that some of this stuff has to be taught.

quotes.speaker: Michael Malone
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Malone on roster construction and team balance
quotes.excerpt: I think every year the roster makeup is what is available
quotes.quote: I think every year the roster makeup is what is available, and then I think also you look at your weaknesses and you like to have the back end be different than the front end. I have said this before, we have had more talented rosters here, but sometimes having the same kind of players one through 15 can hurt you in certain situations. So, it is cool to have different kinds of players.
quotes.social_post: Michael Malone on roster construction: We have had more talented rosters here, but sometimes having the same kind of players one through 15 can hurt you in certain situations.

quotes.speaker: Michael Malone
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Malone on Cam Johnson's defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: Very good weak side defender. That is the thing about our league
quotes.quote: Very good weak side defender. That is the thing about our league is people, I love when people say someone is on a good on-ball defender, who is? I mean, there is probably like 25 of them in our whole league. So, it is all about IQ, where to send the ball, and once you send the ball that way, you got to trust the people behind you. Cam Johnson is very trustworthy in every way.
quotes.social_post: Michael Malone on Cam Johnson: Very good weak side defender. It is all about IQ, where to send the ball, and once you send the ball that way, you got to trust the people behind you.

quotes.speaker: Michael Malone
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic's passing ability
quotes.excerpt: That is, I know I think that is one of the best passes ever
quotes.quote: That is, I know I think that is one of the best passes ever. To be honest, live I did not realize, you know, just the the angle of it. When I watched on tape, I almost fell over. I just cannot believe, there has been stuff, I mean I am lucky. I have seen Magic play and Bird and all those guys and you see things that they do and how they see it before it happens.
quotes.social_post: Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic: I have seen Magic play and Bird and all those guys and you see things that they do and how they see it before it happens.
